title: Meetings
subtitle: Meeting-room bookings and who actually came, measured by the room's access readers.

meetings.emptyHint: Nothing is booked in this period.
meetings.noRoomsHint: No meeting room is set up yet: create one on the Rooms tab first.

detail.noReader: This room has no access reader, so attendance cannot be measured. Install a terminal with the punch role "Door / meeting-room reader" in the room's location.
detail.cancelHint: The room is released and the invitees are no longer expected. The access log keeps every entry.

form.title: New meeting
form.hint: Times are in the room's local time ({{zone}}).
form.endBeforeStart: The meeting must end after it starts.
form.tooLong: A meeting lasts at most 12 hours.
form.lateAfterHint: Entering the room later than this after the start counts as late.
form.overCapacity: The room holds {{capacity}} people; {{count}} are invited.

rooms.hint: A meeting room is a place of the location tree (Organisation → Locations); its readers are the access readers installed in that place.
rooms.emptyHint: Create a room from a place of your location tree, then install an access reader in that place.

fields.locationHint: The place (room, floor, zone…) that is the meeting room. It cannot be changed later.
fields.noPlaces: No place in the location tree yet: add the rooms, floors or zones under Organisation → Locations first.
fields.name: Name
fields.capacityHint: Most invitees a meeting may have; leave empty for no limit.
fields.restrictedHint: Only the departments and employees below, and the invitees of a meeting in progress, may enter. Every other entry is reported as unauthorised.
fields.activeHint: An inactive room cannot be booked.

access.hint: Every entry through a meeting-room reader. Unauthorised: the room is restricted and the person was neither allowed nor invited to the meeting in progress.
access.emptyHint: No one used a meeting-room reader in this period.
